title: Unticking Create & Edit on Work orders also unticks Delete but keeps View
custom_preconds: 1. In the Work orders card, View, Create & Edit and Delete are all ticked.
custom_steps:
1. Untick the Create & Edit box on Work orders.
  2. Look at View, Create & Edit and Delete.
custom_expected:
Delete unticks automatically.

View stays ticked.

Create & Edit is unticked.
evidence: UI: unticking Work orders Create & Edit clears Delete but keeps View ON.
